papers.title_en: Semantic Alignment of EEG and Text: A Contrastive Learning Framework for Decoding Imagined Speech
papers.authors: Shahryar G. Namdari, Francesco Iacomi, Riccardo Barbieri, Luca Mainardi
papers.evidence: 对比学习将脑电试次与文本嵌入对齐以解码想象语音
papers.tldr: 本研究针对想象语音解码中传统闭集分类器忽视语义关系、输出灵活性受限的问题，提出多模态对比学习框架，将EEG信号与冻结预训练文本编码器的嵌入空间对齐。通过复合目标训练EEG编码器，在Chisco数据集上取得与任务优化闭集分类器相当的解码性能，同时支持相似性检索、可靠性排序和语义结构评估，为灵活脑机接口提供新途径。
papers.abstract_en: Imagined speech decoding from EEG offers a promising route toward naturalistic brain-computer interfaces. Traditional closed-set classifiers treat semantic categories as independent labels and do not explicitly exploit relationships among linguistic intents, limiting output flexibility. We adapt a multimodal contrastive learning framework to imagined speech, aligning EEG trials with language representations in the embedding space of a frozen pretrained text encoder. An EEG encoder is trained with a composite objective combining semantically reweighted EEG-sentence alignment and text-prototype-based class discrimination, encouraging semantic structure while preserving separability among 39 intent categories. We evaluate the approach on the Chisco imagined speech dataset across five subjects, reporting Top-k accuracy, macro-F1, and balanced pairwise matching accuracy (2v2). We also investigate maximum EEG-text cosine similarity (MaxCosine) as an intrinsic indicator of decoding reliability and probe semantic structure beyond category labels using five evaluation-time semantic axes and a qualitative Semantic Gallery Probe (SGP) with previously unseen candidate sentences. The contrastive framework achieved decoding performance comparable to a task-optimized closed-set classifier while mapping EEG into a frozen language embedding space. MaxCosine identified subsets of held-out trials with higher Top-1 and Top-5 accuracy across subjects. Evaluation-time semantic axes showed mean agreement above the 50% chance reference across all five dimensions, and the SGP qualitatively illustrated direct comparison with unseen candidate sentences. Together, these findings suggest that EEG-language alignment can retain comparable fixed-intent decoding while supporting similarity-based retrieval, intrinsic reliability ranking, and evaluation of broader semantic structure.

papers.title_en: How large an effect would we have seen? Positive controls, detection floors and dataset pitfalls in scalp-EEG speech decoding
papers.evidence: 头皮脑电语音解码，阳性对照，检测下限
papers.tldr: 头皮脑电图言语解码研究常用显性言语作阳性对照但未报告可检测效应大小。本研究利用三个公开数据集审计显性/想象言语解码，通过注入已知效应测量检测下限，发现阳性对照主要由肌电信号主导，且数据集标签存在陷阱，呼吁报告带限准确率和检测下限。
papers.abstract_en: Objective. Studies that decode imagined speech from scalp electroencephalography (EEG) commonly validate their pipelines with a positive control, usually overt speech, and report null results without stating what effect size the pipeline could have detected. Approach. Using ds003626 ("Thinking out loud"), KaraOne and Track 3 of the 2020 International Brain-Computer Interface Competition, we audited decoding of overt speech, articulator preparation and imagined speech with artifact-channel subsets, band-limited decoding and trial selection, under a protocol that enforces split integrity by assertion. We injected class-dependent effects of known amplitude into the real recordings to measure the detection floor of five decoder families, and we checked the ds003626 labels against the dataset's acquisition protocol. Main results. On ds003626, two lip electrodes decoded overt speech at 0.7430 and the eight external channels at 0.7068, against 0.4231 for the 128-channel scalp montage, and no decodable signal survived in the 8-30 Hz band. On the other two corpora, within-subject accuracy rose monotonically with frequency into the range dominated by muscle activity. Band-power logistic regression detected an injected 8-30 Hz desynchronization of 0.54 uV under a criterion fixed in advance, whereas a compact convolutional network (EEGNet) detected nothing within subject up to 4.31 uV. In ds003626, the condition codes are the reverse of the intuitive reading, the class encoding changed between public releases, and condition is a deterministic function of time within each session. Significance. In these corpora the overt-speech positive control is dominated by myogenic signal and cannot validate a decoding pipeline. We recommend that speech-decoding studies report band-limited and artifact-channel accuracy, the direction of accuracy across frequency, and a measured detection floor.

papers.title_en: Cross-subject decoding of imagined speech from scalp EEG: a leakage-controlled evaluation on three public corpora
papers.evidence: 从EEG跨被试解码想象语音
papers.tldr: 本研究评估头皮脑电图想象语音解码的跨被试迁移能力，在三个公共数据集上采用严格防泄漏协议。结果显示482对被试对无一通过多重比较校正，平均迁移准确率接近随机；个体内解码仅竞赛数据勉强超过阈值且受伪迹影响。结论指出想象语音内容未跨被试转移，增加每类试验次数比改进模型更关键。
papers.abstract_en: Objective. A decoder of imagined speech that works for a new user without calibration would make a non-invasive speech interface practical. We tested whether imagined-speech content recorded with scalp electroencephalography (EEG) transfers across people, and examined why accuracy within a single person remains low. Approach. We analyzed three public corpora, ds003626, KaraOne and Track 3 of the 2020 International Brain-Computer Interface Competition, under a protocol that enforces split integrity by assertion and reports exact binomial thresholds, group tests and bootstrap confidence intervals. We trained decoders on each participant and tested them on every other, compared representational geometry across participants without a classifier, applied subject-level alignment, and tested five explanations for the within-subject ceiling. Main results. Across 482 ordered pairs of participants, no pair survived correction for multiple comparisons; mean pair-transfer accuracy lay within 0.006 of chance on every corpus, while every within-subject reference lay above it. Imagery against pre-stimulus rest generalized at about 0.61 after artifact and elapsed-time controls, but its decoder labelled the interval preceding imagery as imagery as often as imagery itself, so the contrast reflects a post-stimulus state, not imagery. Within subject, only the competition corpus decoded above threshold for every participant (0.3147; chance 0.200); syllable count explained little of this, but its frequency profile failed an artifact audit. Significance. In these corpora, imagined-speech content did not transfer between people through any representation we examined. Trial count per class was the only variable that ordered the corpora, which favors larger single-condition datasets over further model development.

papers.title_en: Statistical Mechanics of Spike Trains: Self-Consistent Activity Ensembles and Phase Transitions
papers.authors: Jan Pyrzowski, Laura Messio, Guillaume Marrelec, Marcin Markiewicz
papers.evidence: 将外部输入与尖峰序列联系起来的统计力学框架
papers.tldr: 本文提出脉冲序列的统计力学框架，将完整脉冲时空构型视为微观状态，通过有效能量与温度构建玻尔兹曼分布，研究群体活动宏观态及其相变。分析表明存在振荡与非振荡两类活动机制，通过熵、局域化和自相关等序参量诊断。蒙特卡洛模拟验证了理论预测，揭示了自由能景观。
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a statistical-mechanical framework for spiking neuronal systems in which entire spike trains, defined as spatiotemporal configurations of discrete events, are treated as microstates of the system. Instead of modeling explicit network dynamics, we construct an ensemble over complete spike histories and assign to each configuration an effective energy functional that quantifies its consistency with intrinsic synaptic interactions.   This formulation leads to a Boltzmann-like distribution over spike configurations, where an effective temperature captures the influence of external inputs acting as a stochastic drive. Macroscopic states are described in terms of coarse-grained observables, such as population firing-rate densities, and arise from a competition between energetic contributions favoring interaction-consistent spike patterns and entropic contributions favoring spatio-temporal disorder.   Within this framework, we primarily characterize the transition between oscillatory and non-oscillatory activity. The non-oscillatory regime contains both broadly distributed, approximately uniform states and temporally localized collapsed states, whereas the oscillatory regime is characterized by repeated activity peaks. These regimes are diagnosed using order parameters derived from the population spike-rate density, including its entropy, temporal localization measures, and autocorrelation-based indicators.   To complement the analytical treatment, we perform Monte Carlo simulations that sample the ensemble of admissible spike configurations using a Metropolis-Hastings scheme defined directly on spike trains. The simulations reveal the emergence of the predicted macroscopic regimes and provide a direct sampling-based probe of the free-energy landscape.

papers.title_en: A hidden Markov model for unsupervised EEG-based tracking of auditory attention to a single voice
papers.authors: Tianyi Li, Simon Geirnaert, Davina Van den Broek, Elien Bellon, Bert De Smedt, Alexander Bertrand
papers.evidence: 使用隐马尔可夫模型解码EEG听觉注意力
papers.tldr: 本文针对绝对听觉注意解码中缺少竞争语音参考导致的跟踪困难，提出一种结合神经包络跟踪与隐马尔可夫模型的无监督流水线，仅利用EEG和目标语音包络估计连续注意轨迹。实验在30名被试上验证，5秒窗口平均AUC达0.858，优于移动平均平滑和替代特征，展示了概率时间推断在单说话人场景中的有效性。
papers.abstract_en: Objective: Absolute auditory attention decoding (aAAD) aims to track how strongly a listener attends to a single speech source using electroencephalography (EEG). Unlike selective auditory attention decoding, aAAD lacks a competing speech reference, making reliable attention tracking challenging.   Approach: We propose a fully unsupervised aAAD pipeline combining neural envelope tracking (NET) with hidden Markov model (HMM)-based temporal inference. Using EEG signals and the target speech envelope, the framework estimates a continuous attention trajectory without explicit attention-state labels. We evaluate the approach using EEG recordings from 30 adults, investigate the impact of analysis window length, and compare HMM post-processing with moving-average (MA) smoothing and alternative EEG features.   Main results: With 1-s analysis windows, non-causal HMM post-processing improves the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) for all 30 participants, increasing mean AUC from 0.547 for raw NET to 0.832. A 5-s window achieves the highest mean AUC of 0.858. Compared with non-causal MA smoothing, the HMM achieves higher AUC across the examined smoothing scales. Individual switch detection times are comparable, while the HMM generally achieves lower group-level detection times. NET also outperforms alpha power and spectral entropy as an observation feature in the unsupervised HMM framework.   Significance: The proposed framework provides a label-free approach for estimating temporal fluctuations in auditory attention, demonstrating the utility of probabilistic temporal inference for continuous attention tracking in single-speaker listening scenarios.

papers.title_en: Decomposing Brain-LLM Alignment with Interpretable Semantic Representations
papers.evidence: 使用可解释语义表示分解脑-LLM对齐，解释编码模型内部机制
papers.tldr: 本研究针对大语言模型预测大脑语言反应但可解释性不足的问题，使用SCRIBE可解释语义表示对LLaMA2-7B的大脑对齐进行分解。通过对自然故事fMRI数据的方差分解，发现共享方差在大脑和语言区域中占主导，且具体语义属性比抽象属性共享更多方差。消融实验显示语义贡献跨多维度累积。结果表明LLM大脑对齐的相当部分可由可解释语义信息解释，同时存在模型之外的互补信息。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) predict neural responses during naturalistic language comprehension, but the linguistic information underlying this brain alignment remains difficult to interpret. We use SCRIBE, an interpretable contextual semantic representation spanning 65 neurocognitively grounded semantic properties, as a lens for decomposing the brain alignment of one LLM, LLaMA2-7B. Using variance partitioning between LLaMA2-7B and SCRIBE on naturalistic fMRI data from seven participants listening to narrative stories (Moth Radio Hour), we separate brain-predictive variance shared between the two representations from variance unique to each. We find that shared variance is the dominant component across the whole brain and language-related regions, while both representations also retain significant unique contributions. We then examine whether the concreteness of individual semantic properties relates to shared and SCRIBE-unique brain-predictive variance. Concrete properties show greater shared variance with LLaMA2-7B than abstract properties across the whole brain and most examined regions, whereas abstract properties do not show greater SCRIBE-unique variance. Finally, property ablations reveal that semantic contributions extend across multiple dimensions, with cumulative effects on both shared and SCRIBE-unique variance. Together, these results show that, for LLaMA2-7B on this dataset, a substantial portion of brain-LLM alignment is associated with interpretable semantic information, while revealing complementary brain-predictive semantic information beyond the LLaMA2-7B representation.

papers.title_en: SCRIBE: Scalable Contextual Representations of Interpretable Brain-Grounded Semantics
papers.authors: Camila Kolling, Omer Moussa, Emin Çelik, Mariya Toneva
papers.evidence: 将语义特征与脑活动记录相关联
papers.tldr: 针对语义依赖上下文且难以在真实语言中研究的问题，本文提出SCRIBE框架，利用开源大语言模型集成生成可解释的上下文相关词级语义表示。行为与神经实验表明，SCRIBE能捕捉人类语义判断的上下文变化，达到人类噪声上限的75-81%，并预测语言脑区反应，优于非上下文表示，且包含句法特征之外的独特信息，为研究自然语言脑语义提供了可扩展基础。
papers.abstract_en: Understanding how the human brain constructs meaning from real-world language remains a fundamental challenge, as semantics depend on context that varies in natural settings. To enable the study of real-world linguistic meaning in the brain, we introduce SCRIBE, a framework grounded in a neuroscience-informed semantic space that leverages an ensemble of open-source large language models to generate interpretable, word-level semantic representations of arbitrary text. In a behavioral study with 921 participants, we show that human semantic feature judgments vary systematically with context, and that SCRIBE captures these shifts, reaching 75-81% of the estimated human noise ceiling. Using brain activity recorded while participants listen to naturalistic stories, we further demonstrate that SCRIBE predicts neural responses in language-selective brain regions, significantly outperforming non-contextual semantic representations. Variance partitioning reveals that SCRIBE explains unique brain-predictive information beyond syntactic features, suggesting that its representations capture aspects of linguistic meaning not accounted for by the measured syntactic features. Together, these findings establish SCRIBE as a scalable and interpretable foundation for studying natural language semantics in the brain.

papers.title_en: On Sleep-Wake Disorder Identification from Polysomnographic Representations
papers.authors: Alvise Dei Rossi, Luigi Fiorillo, Giuliana Monachino, Alessia Calzoni, Julia van der Meer, Markus H. Schmidt, Claudio L. A. Bassetti, Silvia Santini, Francesca Faraci
papers.evidence: 使用整夜状态空间模型从多导睡眠图表示解码睡眠-觉醒障碍
papers.tldr: 本研究在7906个多导睡眠图上，采用整夜缺失感知状态空间框架，比较自监督多导睡眠图基础模型与睡眠分期监督编码器对六类睡眠-觉醒障碍的多标签识别。发现监督预训练达到可比规模与模态覆盖时，其性能反超自监督模型且数据效率更高，强调需设置匹配基线评估基础模型。
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised polysomnography foundation models (PSG FMs) aim to capture clinically useful information beyond sleep staging, yet are rarely compared with sleep-staging encoders pretrained at comparable scale and modality coverage. Using a common whole-night, missingness-aware state-space downstream modeling framework, we compared frozen representations from prominent large-scale, multi-cohort sleep-stage-supervised encoders and self-supervised PSG FMs for multilabel identification of six sleep-wake and circadian disorder groups in 7,906 PSGs from an unseen registry. Although PSG FMs outperformed an EEG-only, single-cohort supervised baseline, this ordering reversed when supervised pretraining approached comparable scale and modality coverage. Transfer learning from neural sleep scorers achieved higher overall performance while exhibiting greater downstream data efficiency. These findings underscore the need for scale- and modality-matched pretrained supervised baselines when assessing PSG FMs' downstream potential.

papers.title_en: Multi-System Cognitive Steering for Generative Communication
papers.authors: Eric Lacosse, Pablo Tano, Daniel C. McNamee
papers.evidence: 从缩写输入和多模态上下文重建用户意图用于思维到语音
papers.tldr: 思想转语音受限于运动输入成本，生成式AI可扩展缩写输入但常误解用户意图。本文提出认知引导框架，通过将大语言模型基于多模态上下文（环境指涉物、情绪状态、沟通动机）并应用AI控制方法重建用户意图。在模拟缩写基准上，对齐前沿模型实现约88%的top-5扩展准确率，为无上下文基线的两倍；且不同上下文需不同控制技术（物理对象用文本提示，情绪等抽象因素直接改变内部激活）。这支持未来混合架构界面，结合多种AI控制方法实现快速准确通信。
papers.abstract_en: A fundamental bottleneck for translating thoughts to speech is the high physical cost of motor input forcing a strict tradeoff between communication speed and expressivity. Generative AI offers a promising solution by expanding highly abbreviated text input into fluent sentences, significantly reducing the motor burden on the user. However, sparse inputs are inherently ambiguous; without sufficient context, AI models frequently misinterpret these abbreviations and generate outputs that fail to align with the user's true cognitive intent. We propose \textit{Cognitive Steering}, a framework that can be leveraged to reconstruct user intent by grounding Large Language Models (LLMs) in multimodal context and applying AI control methods. We demonstrate that aligning frontier models with selected environmental referents, emotional states, and communication motives on simulated abbreviation benchmarks achieves up to $\sim$88\% top-5 expansion accuracy, doubling no-context baselines. We also reveal that different types of context require distinct AI control techniques: while physical objects in a scene are best provided through explicit text prompts, abstract factors like emotion may be more effectively managed by directly altering the AI's internal activations. These findings suggest a hybrid architecture for future interfaces that leverage Cognitive Steering to help users communicate both quickly and accurately, recruiting multiple AI control methods simultaneously to perfectly capture their intended communication goals.

papers.title_en: How Long Is the Coast of a Neuron? Resolution-Dependent Interaction Order and Computational Capacity
papers.evidence: 分析神经计算中的交互阶与计算容量
papers.tldr: 本文受曼德博海岸线悖论启发，探究观测分辨率如何塑造神经计算外观结构。作者提出尺度索引分解，分离直接依赖捕获的预测信息与模型族外残差，发现投影可将高阶依赖转为成对结构，解析非线性亚单位能提升表征秩但未必增加目标信息。结论指出，点神经元或直接群体模型仅在特定尺度上建立有效描述，不能唯一识别更精细计算，分辨率是否足够取决于观测与扰动。
papers.abstract_en: Mandlebrot's coastline paradox reframes measurement as a joint property of an object and its ruler. Here we ask how observational resolution shapes the apparent structure of neural computation. We introduce a scale-indexed decomposition that separates the predictive information captured by direct dependencies from the residual outside that model family. Exact constructions show that projection can convert higher-order dependence into pairwise structure. Projection can increase the direct fraction of surviving information even as total predictive information decreases. A schematic branch-to-soma cascade grounds these effects in local coincidence detection, saturating integration and somatic mixing. Resolving organized nonlinear subunits improves approximation and raises effective representational rank. In a nested hierarchy, these gains occur without increasing information about the target. This distinction separates information availability from access by a restricted readout. A point-neuron or direct population model therefore establishes an effective description at a specified scale. It does not uniquely identify the finer computation that generated the observed relation. Which resolution is adequate depends on the observable and perturbation of interest.

papers.title_en: Design and Analysis of Temporal Representations in Neural Networks
papers.evidence: 定义了神经网络中时间表示的程度，涵盖编码与解码功能
papers.tldr: 本文提出神经网络时间表示程度概念，依据激活、学习、编码、解码函数是否显式操作时间划分连续谱。在固定深度架构中比较非时间加权和、非时间二值脉冲与基于脉冲时间的激活，实验表明提高时间表示程度能提升事件数据集的性能和计算效率，并在 Google Speech Commands 上取得最优结果，同时揭示梯度依赖事件时间历史。
papers.abstract_en: The ability to represent temporal information is often hypothesized to underlie the efficiency and learning capabilities of biological neural networks. This motivates the development of spiking neural networks. However, it remains unclear how temporal information is actually represented in neural networks and how different forms of temporal representation affect performance and computational efficiency. We introduce the notion of the degree of temporal representation of a neural network, defined by whether its constituent functions (activation, learning, encoding, and decoding) explicitly manipulate time as a computational variable. This perspective yields a continuum ranging from non-temporal representations, where time does not explicitly appear as a computational variable in the network functions, to fully temporal representations, where computations explicitly operate on temporal variables. Using a fixed deep architecture, we compare different encoding, activation mechanisms and decoding with increasing temporal expressiveness: non-temporal weighted-sum activations used in usual artificial neural networks, non-temporal binary spiking activations used in spiking neural networks, and spike-time-based activations used in delay neural networks. Experiments on event-based datasets show that increasing the degree of temporal representation improves both performance and computational efficiency, allowing state-of-the-art performances on the Google Speech Commands dataset. We further analyze how temporal representations induce distinct forward and backward computational trajectories, leading to gradients that depend explicitly on the history of event times.

papers.title_en: Beyond the Hamming Cliff: Compact Spatial Encodings Preserving Semantic Distance in Spiking Neural Networks
papers.authors: Sergio Davies, Muhammad Aitsam, Morgan-Tyler Stone, Alessandro Di Nuovo, Liangxiu Han
papers.evidence: 将连续值编码为脉冲神经网络的脉冲模式
papers.tldr: 针对脉冲神经网络中二进制编码的“汉明悬崖”问题，该研究在SpiNNaker硬件上比较了Gray、Thermometer、Johnson及新提出的混合编码方案，通过预处理输入信号实现超低延迟处理。结果表明消除悬崖必要但不充分，Gray缺乏全局距离结构，而混合编码能以较小码宽恢复大部分语义距离，并揭示稳态因子决定容差半径和相似性判断。
papers.abstract_en: By pre-processing input signals with Gray, Thermometer, Johnson and hybrid encodings before passing them to spiking neural networks running on SpiNNaker hardware, Davies et al.(2025) address the semantic-spatial disparity that causes the ``Hamming cliff'' in standard binary representations. Continuous semantic patterns are presented as a set of simultaneous spikes at the input layer, preserving ultra-low latency processing. Training the network on multiple continuous values under each scheme, and measuring accuracy, required homeostatic scaling and false-positive rates, shows that removing the cliff is necessary but not sufficient: Gray encoding removes it yet retains little global distance structure, whereas Thermometer and Johnson preserve semantic distance at a code width that grows with the value range. The proposed hybrid encodings contain all three as limiting cases of a single parameter, recovering most of that structure at a fraction of the width. The homeostatic factor is shown to set a radius of tolerance around each trained pattern, so that the choice of encoding alone decides which values the network treats as similar.
